list.name: filter
list.label: Extra LogsQL filter
list.description: Default hides WebDAV sync and LAN IPv4. Set to * to see everything.

panels.title: Blocked at edge (403/429)
panels.description: DownstreamStatus 403/429 with OriginStatus 0: answered by Traefik middleware (crowdsec / rate-limit) and never reached the backend.

targets.expr: app:traefik RouterName:$router $filter DownstreamStatus:in(403,429) OriginStatus:0 | stats count() hits
app:traefik RouterName:$router $filter DownstreamStatus:>=500 | stats count() hits
app:traefik RouterName:$router $filter | stats by (DownstreamStatus) count() hits
app:traefik RouterName:$router $filter DownstreamStatus:in(403,429) OriginStatus:0 | stats by (RouterName) count() hits
app:traefik RouterName:$router $filter | stats by (RouterName) quantile(0.95, Duration) p95 | math p95 / 1e6 as p95
app:traefik RouterName:$router $filter | stats by (ClientHost, geo_country, geo_city, geo_as_org) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 20
app:traefik RouterName:$router $filter DownstreamStatus:in(403,429) OriginStatus:0 | stats by (ClientHost, geo_country, geo_city, geo_as_org) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 20
app:traefik RouterName:$router $filter | stats by (RouterName, _msg) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 20
app:traefik RouterName:$router $filter DownstreamStatus:404 | stats by (RouterName, _msg) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 20
app:traefik RouterName:$router $filter | stats by ("request_User-Agent") count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 20
app:traefik RouterName:$router $filter geo_country:* | stats by (geo_country) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 20
app:traefik RouterName:$router $filter geo_city:* | stats by (geo_country, geo_city) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 20
app:traefik RouterName:$router $filter geo_as_org:* | stats by (geo_asn, geo_as_org) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 20

app:traefik RouterName:$router $filter Duration:>2000000000 | fields _time, entryPointName, RouterName, ClientHost, geo_country, geo_city, geo_as_org, RequestMethod, _msg, DownstreamStatus, OriginStatus, Duration | sort by (Duration) desc | limit 200
